Third-party software in cadcraft_dxf_bg.wasm
Crates linked into the WebAssembly build (normal dependencies on wasm32-unknown-unknown; proc-macros and build tools are not shipped).
CADCraft itself: see LICENSE-MIT. Where a crate offers a choice of licenses, it is used under the one marked "used under".
